class.name: WorldSection
class.brief_description: What is drawn of one cell of a world.
class.description: One cell of [SceneryStreamingServer]'s grid: its layers' meshes, models and lines, in the world's coordinates. Read when the camera comes within reach of the cell and let go once it has left ([code]WorldSectionProvider[/code]). Saved by its class name, it names no script.

members.member: The cell of the streaming grid it is.
